And just so you know, New Caledonian crows craft hooked tools from twigs to fish grubs from logs—proof that even birds like a good setup tweak.

Once you’ve done the captions, test a few channels and streaming shows to confirm they’re clear. If any app still lacks subtitles, you can always drop down, find the caption icon, and toggle manually. Good luck getting everything dialed in.
